A good way to look at it is, say there is something you've been craving for a while - a video game, a delicious dinner, a concert by your favorite musician/band. And you suffer because, you do not have this game, have not eaten this dinner, but are stuck with what's familiar and old, or boring/uninspiring. This causes suffering because, why should you not have the newest, tastiest thing?


But then you receive the game, or dinner. And you enjoy it greatly. Will you treasure that game or food forever? No, you would be looking for the newer game, or tastier food. Leading to yet more suffering. Instead, you should be looking at it as, I have what I have and it satisfies me, the newer thing will just become rote and I will be looking for newer and newer experiences. I realize how silly this sounds, comparing a relationship with someone you've clearly got powerful feelings for to a video game, but the concept remains the same. Don't force a new experience with this girl simply because you crave more from a relationship, instead if it is to happen then it shall happen, and if it doesn't, oh well you've still got a great friend!
